Hi! I’m Louie.

Hi! I’m Louie.

I’m an AI Driven Voice Interface for
Apps & Websites

I’m an AI Driven

Voice Interface for

Apps & Websites

Louie SDK can voice enable any app or website in the world, be it Android or iOS.

Louie Voice SDK provides a multilingual voice interface, enabling a user to do end-to-end transactions within apps & websites, with just voice commands.

Highly versatile, works across sectors... Banking, Taxi Hailing, Food Ordering, Healthcare, E-Commerce, Insurance, Payments...

See Louie in Action

Keyboard Interface was the Past.

Touch Interface is the Present.

Voice Interface is the Future.

The Future is here!

Can Google Assistant, Siri do
what Louie can?

LOUIE VOICE

Uber Booking with Louie Voice

GOOGLE ASSISTANT

Uber Booking with Google Assistant

SIRI

Uber Booking with Siri

How Louie can Voice Enable
your App & Website

SDK Plug-in

Integrates with & voice enables any mobile app (iOS & Android) or website in the world

AI Driven Voice Interface

Driven by advanced LLM Voice AI technology

Humanoid Gesture Control

Patent filed for unique Proprietary Technology, enabling end to end transactions

40 Global Languages

Multilingual Voice Interface, even if the customer app is in English only

Privacy & Security

Foolproof InfoSec through hosting of Louie SDK & LLM model on customer’s Private Cloud / Servers

Permission Required

Microphone Permission only!

SDK Size

Small SDK size under 1MB

SDK Integration

Heavy lifting done by Louie Team. Customer source code not required

Customized User Experience

Louie SDK is a custom built for every app & website, delivering unique voice experience

Which languages Louie can support?

40
Global
Languages

Can Louie drive Inclusion & Accessibility?

Louie Voice Interface
cuts across

Louie Voice Interface cuts across

  • Disabilities
  • Age Groups
  • Literacy Level
  • Language Barriers
  • Accessibility of a different order

  • Louie Voice Interface will understand the User Intent & just get the work done, without the user knowing where the specific menus & buttons are.

My Creator

Pramit (Louie Founder), built Louie to solve his own personal challenge of vision impairment, driven by a simple thought- " why can't I control an app end to end with just my voice commands".

Pramit is a graduate from India's leading Tech and Management Institutes (IIT, IIM). He has worked with Global MNCs such as Unilever, Motorola, Quest Diagnostics.

Our Customers

Banks

Payment Apps

Mutual Funds

Louie Voice is a sector agnostic Voice Interface and can voice enable any iOS and Android app, or any Website in the World.
